note: The plan says captions only with push-ins on the cheque and watch, so 6 light graphics and no full-frame cards.

mg.title: Volunteer tag
mg.src: Dwayne, Day 1 pm .MOV [00:13.0] “we can use people to volunteer.”
mg.use: Small tag on “volunteer”, after the hook text goes out at 00:03.

mg.title: Give tag
mg.src: Dwayne, Day 1 pm .MOV [00:17.7] “Some will give us financial support.”
mg.use: Small tag on “give” during the cheque push-in. Never over the cheque.

mg.title: Focus on the watch
mg.use: Frames the watch during the push-in. Move it to where the watch sits. Keep the cheque blur on.

mg.title: Their voice

text.main: And some will just give us their voice

mg.use: Over the wide desk shot on the first words of the row. Keep captions on.

mg.title: A hand up

text.main: a hand up and not just another hand out.

mg.use: On the key line, at the top. Hold it through the 0.5 s of air, then out before the ask.

mg.title: Comment I'm in
mg.src: The ask text in the plan, row 00:24–00:30. Dwayne, Day 1 pm .MOV [00:36.2] “comment, I'm in, or message me.”
mg.use: The one ask. In on the word “comment”, big and centered. Hold it to the end card.
